basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old software developer based in Austin, Texas, with a passion for gaming and cryptocurrencies. I spend my working hours developing blockchain solutions, and in my free time, I indulge in my love for Animal Crossing and fantasy literature. I am usually online in the evenings, often browsing Reddit while sipping on a cup of coffee. I'm currently in a relationship and enjoy discussing philosophical topics and economic theories. I dislike early mornings and overly crowded places.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over 7 years. My expertise lies in blockchain technology, which I initially explored during my university days and later honed through professional experiences and personal projects. I'm also a self-taught enthusiast in game design and narrative storytelling.
